description:
Title: Chainsaw

You produce custom chainsaws on demand.
Your chainsaws have at least 5 properties such as length of the "guide bar" (Schwertlaenge), chain width, electric or motor chainsaw.
After your customer told you the properties, you can start ordering the parts from various online sources (in parallel).
After the parts arrive you have to do a manual inspection of all parts, and then assemble the parts.
During production, you regularly send updates to your customer.
After producing the first saw you send it to your customer.
If he likes it, the rest of his order are produced.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties (at least five)"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstChainsaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ChainsawProduction" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerProperties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrive" name="All ordered parts arrive"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" name="Produce and send updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw" name="Assemble the first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstChainsaw"
                   name="Send first chainsaw to customer"
                   messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision"
                      name="Receive customer's decision"
                      messageRef="Message_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?">
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_NotLiked" name="Customer does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws" name="Produce the rest of the order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProductionUpdates"
                   name="Send production updates"
                   messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" name="Production and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Production" name="Production ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="Start_CustomerProperties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_Arrive" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrive_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrive" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Split" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Assemble" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendProductionUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_SendFirst" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirst_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_Liked" name="Customer likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Remaining_Join" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendProductionUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" targetRef="End_Production"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_ChainsawProduction"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerProperties"
                      name="Chainsaw properties"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Start_CustomerProperties"
                      messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductionUpdate"
                      name="Production update"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendProductionUpdates"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstChainsaw"
                      name="First chainsaw"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerDecision"
                      name="Customer decision"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision"
                      messageRef="Message_CustomerDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
